per_proof_checks.mathematical_check: Publicly identifies the sole literal declaration change from stochastic radius to deterministic radius R_delta, preserving all domains and all-radius uniformity. Rate(0)=0, uniform mean rate and exact half-quadratic square completion give the signed ceiling without optimizer or positive-control identification. Physical free-factor-inclusive Young growth, convexity and weighted p/r power means explicitly give A0, eta_B, and A1 B^(3nu), including cancellation of B^(nu/r) against B^(-nu/r), all zero/p=nu cases and the original covariance single control action.

Publicly checks deterministic finite error on all radii/control balls, nonnegative rate and zero control, then correctly applies the named polynomial arbitrary-residual theorem with fixed-B vanishing anchor to obtain e_B→0. Exact Gaussian radial integration is split using ||Phi||≤rho, not equality or attainment. Bulk factor M²/(2delta) and tail factor four are retained. The public tail calculation correctly splits -rho²/4 into -M²/8-rho²/8 and integrates the latter exponential, yielding total -M²/4 under 4A1 B^(3nu)≤M^(2-nu). No infinite-dimensional density or unjustified Laplace principle.

Publicly computes the polynomial cutoff ratio including zero A1, bounds a positive sum by twice its larger term and retains both logarithmic prefactors. Fixed B comes before delta→0; all normalizers and the typical radius vanish. The same actual endpoint M_delta is B-independent by restart, so only then B→infinity removes e_B and sends A0-M_B²/4 to minus infinity. Lower bound uses the stated original endpoint norm, with the direct free case separately identified. No assumed signed-score limit or diagonal B(delta).

Publicly applies the original point transfer with negligible polynomial datum cost and exact bijective T/delta reparametrization, then the reconstructed signed operator upper bound and original-law stationarity at each fixed x. Log finiteness and unit empty pairing are checked. The rephrased original sentence retains regularization-first, full-chain and canonical-law qualifications. Zero covariance is directly treated with trivial control space/score and free-flow polynomial norm; formal a→0 exponent is not promoted to an endpoint theorem or source-constant identification.
